name: bombadil-zulip-spec
description: Bombadil specification for the ephemeral Zulip test instance. Type-checking does not need this: spec/tsconfig.json maps the module paths onto the bombadil/ checkout's TypeScript sources, so `make typecheck` works without an npm install. The devDependency is recorded for editors that would rather resolve from node_modules, and pins the same version as BOMBADIL_IMAGE in .env.
